label: pSC101 ori (SpeI-free BioBrick form)
note: The SpeI-free BioBrick form of the pSC101 origin: the native origin with two changes (T22A, A23T) that remove the ACTAGT SpeI site at its bases 20-25. The iGEM Registry record of the pSC101 origin (BBa_I50042) describes it as carrying "mutations introduced to eliminate a SpeI site" and as "the origin of replication in pSB4* series plasmids"; the pSB4A5 backbone carries the same 223 bp. That record calls the origin "supposed to have low copy number", and the pSB4A5 record gives the plasmid's copy number as ~10-12 (citing Lutz & Bujard 1997). Copy-number mutations of pSC101 map in the rep101 gene, not in the origin (Armstrong et al. 1984); no source checked here ties a copy-number phenotype to these two bases, and none ties a temperature sensitivity to any form of this origin.

label: RepA iteron 1
note: First of three tandem ~18 bp direct-repeat iterons (shared 17 bp core TGTAAATTCTGCTAGAC).

label: RepA iteron 2
note: Second RepA-binding iteron; identical 17 bp core (TGTAAATTCTGCTAGAC) to iteron 1, differing only in the leading base (C->T).

label: RepA iteron 3
note: Third (innermost) RepA-binding iteron; differs from iterons 1/2 by a single central base (T->C, core CCGCTAGAC).

label: AT-rich bending region
note: AT-rich tract (82.4% AT) lying between the iterons and the DnaA box.

label: DnaA
note: DnaA-box-like motif on the reverse strand (revcomp of seq[211:220] = TTATACACA; near the DnaA consensus TTAT[C/A]CACA).

provenance.sequence_source: iGEM Registry BBa_I50042 'pSC101 origin of replication' (created 2007), complement(616..838), 100% over 223 bp; identical in the pSB4A5 backbone (complement(799..1021))

source.quote: The pSC101 origin of replication: the ~220 bp low-copy, iteron-driven cis origin that controls RepA-initiated replication of the narrow-host-range plasmid pSC101.
